assessments.reasoning: The two contiguous parts cover all 26,806 bytes of SPDX's OLDAP-1.4.json. The name field uses “Open LDAP,” licenseText gives the Foundation's 1.4 heading, licenseId is OLDAP-1.4 and isDeprecatedLicenseId is false. crossRef and seeAlso give the claimed gitweb source, with crossRef.match recorded as the string “false.”
The unsigned annotated v3.29.0 tag in spdx/license-list-data has target type commit and target SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. That exact revision appears in the 1.4 detail URL.

The contextual capture at https://git.openldap.org/openldap/openldap/-/raw/c9f95c2f3f2ffb5e0ae55fe7388af75547660941/LICENSE carries the cited hb value in its path and has the claim's publisher digest. The heading and paragraph 8 distinguish the captured 1.4 representation.

challenge.method: Compared 1.4 with the closely related corrected 1.3 detail, checked the extra paragraph 8 wording, and distinguished the SPDX tag object, data commit and OpenLDAP commit.
challenge.results: The 1.4 publisher capture and SPDX text both contain the primary-function qualifier. The 1.3 record lacks it and cites e5f8117f rather than the 1.4 hb value. The SPDX tag points to the commit containing the generated record, while hb identifies the cited OpenLDAP repository revision.

limitations: The historical endpoint's body and any redirect behavior remain unverified. The common commit label and generated SPDX text support documentary correspondence only. They establish no byte equivalence, legal effect, rights, obligations or project-wide applicability.
The 2.8 HTTP and HTTPS release locators are distinct and outside this claim. This review supplies no release qualification.
